_about: Golden argv and command text of the in-chunk acceleration forms on the sample site (tests/marvel0/site_sample.py, model pi05_fr3_all_step49999, the sample instruction); {root} is the rollout root's parent. v1 and v2 were captured from the code BEFORE rule v3 existed and must never change; v3 is the phase client's contract with run_collect_phase.py (design 2026-11-01 section 6).

argv: --prompt=pick the eggplant in the blue plate
--eval-note=marvel0 page: pi05_fr3_all_step49999 chunk accel experimental horizon=6
v1.command:
cd {root}/openpi && \
  env -u VIRTUAL_ENV no_proxy=localhost,127.0.0.1,::1 \
  uv run --no-sync --with pyrealsense2==2.55.1.6486 python lab/chunk_accel/run_collect_accel.py \
  --remote-host=127.0.0.1 --remote-port=8000 --view-camera-id=262622274256 --wrist-camera-id=262622275490 --franka-server-url=http://127.0.0.1:5000/ \
  '--prompt=pick the eggplant in the blue plate' \
  --max-timesteps=500 --eval-num=5 --min-z=0.025 \
  --home-pose 0.481902 -0.011145 0.235951 3.119139 0.008288 -0.883962 --home-duration-s=3.0 \
  --max-xy=0.85 --max-step-m=0.1 --max-step-rad=0.35 --rx-range 1.5 4.03 --ry-range -0.74 0.96 --rz-range -2.44 0.77 \
  --binarize-gripper --require-matching-server --no-allow-unknown-prompt \
  --levi-mode=off --new --no-step-by-step --open-loop-horizon=6 \
  --rollout-root={root}/rollouts --rollout-group=pi05_fr3_all_step49999_accel_demo '--eval-note=marvel0 page: pi05_fr3_all_step49999 chunk accel experimental horizon=6'
